name: manual_ca774b
claim: Fixed-in replies on review threads can wake the Cursor autofix automation: on a closed PR its parallel passes mostly verified and declined to push, yet one pass re-created the deleted branch with duplicate lessons under the operator identity; do not post fixed-in replies on a closed PR, check for pending automation before closing the PR or deleting its branch, read the PR timeline before attributing a branch to another agent, and have the operator scope the automation to open PRs.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit on PR 523: replies posted before closure still woke delayed automation that recreated a deleted branch; retain the closed-PR guidance and require a pending-automation check before close or branch delete.

rationale: CodeRabbit on PR 523: replies posted before closure still woke delayed automation that recreated a deleted branch; retain the closed-PR guidance and require a pending-automation check before close or branch delete.
